author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಉದಧಿಯಲಿ ತೆರೆಸೀಳಿ ನುಗ್ಗುತಿಹ ಹಡಗಂತೆ
ಒದಗಿಬರೊ ಕಷ್ಟಸುಖ ತಾಳುವುದೆ ಬದುಕು
ಹದವಾಗಿ ಬೆರೆತಿರಲು ಜೀವನದಿ ಸಿಹಿಕಹಿಯು
ಮುದದಿಂದ ತರಣಿಸುವೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Like a ship cutting through the waves of the ocean,
life means bearing the sorrows and joys that come;
when sweet and bitter are well blended in life,
you will cross over with delight, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Life is a voyage through waves of joy and sorrow. When we accept both in good measure, we can sail across with a glad heart.
